messages:
mira: Heads up: discovered a subtle typing erosion with our async client and the generated models. When the schema has a field typed as Union[ModelA, str] the streaming helper ends up as AsyncIterator[Any] in the stubs and both mypy/pyright complain in user code.

mira: Minimal example:
```py
resp = await client.chat.completions.create(...)
# resp.items: List[Union[ModelA, str]]
async for chunk in resp.stream():
    reveal_type(chunk)  # shows Any in stubs
```

owen: Repro'd locally. Looks like two places: (1) codegen emits correct Union in models.py but stubgen/templates convert iterator types to Any, (2) our retry/timeout decorator wraps functions with Callable[..., Any] which discards the precise return type.

sam: Workarounds: cast the iterator (gross) or annotate a local var. But this is very noisy for users.

mira: I tried a quick patch: add explicit AsyncIterator[Union[ModelA, str]] to generated .pyi for the .stream method and change the retry decorator typing to use ParamSpec+TypeVar so wrappers preserve return types. That fixed mypy locally.

owen: ParamSpec (PEP 612) is the right move. Note: for py3.9 users we'll need typing_extensions import; add conditional import in our typing utils. Also call out that SDK now requires py3.9+ in package metadata if we rely on some newer typing features.

sam: Another edge: pyright doesn't always follow overloads unless we add overloads on .create and .stream to help type inference: one overload where .create returns Response[ModelOutput] and .stream returns AsyncIterator[ModelOutput]. Then generic path works.

mira: Agree. Also we should prefer named TypeAlias like ModelOutput = Union[ModelA, str] in stubs so error messages are friendlier.

owen: Can we add a small typecheck CI job that runs mypy/pyright against a few repro snippets? Catches regressions quickly.

ci-bot: note: added a flaky typecheck task to devex pipeline last sprint.

sam: I'll open a draft PR with three things: (a) template change for .pyi generation (stream returns AsyncIterator[ModelOutput]), (b) retry decorator typing using ParamSpec/TypeVar, (c) add two unit typecheck tests to devex/ci.

mira: Please include a short note in changelog about typing changes and the typing_extensions bump for older python. Also add an example in docs showing the correct way to annotate streaming items.

owen: Tagging @sam for review and @mira for QA on runtime sanity. I'll run pyright and mypy matrix in CI.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/874 (draft)

ci-bot: ci/status: type-matrix job: running (expected failures until PR merged)
